name: stolen_card_lock_then_expedited_replacement_fee_disclosed
use_case: Service a lost, stolen or damaged card: lock, controls, replacement
branch: The card ending 3382 was stolen; the customer travels in three days and wants the replacement expedited. The fee is $25.00 from the fee schedule in effect, and must be stated before the request.
tests: passes when the agent verifies, locks CARD302, reads the fee from the policy in effect and requests an expedited replacement for CARD302 after the customer accepts the $25.00 fee.
instruction:
Your wallet was stolen this morning with your debit card ending in 3382 in it. You want the card locked immediately and a replacement as fast as possible because you fly out in three days. Ask what the fast option costs; accept the fee if it is $25.00 or less and confirm the expedited replacement. Provide passcode 9023 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Omar Siddiqui
- Customer ID: C302
- Session ID: SESS302
- Card: CARD302 (ending 3382)
- Passcode: 9023

persona.name: Omar Siddiqui
persona.initial_message: My wallet was stolen with my card ending 3382. Lock it now and I need a replacement fast, I fly Thursday.
